audit_target: EXP-033 Feature Flag Activation & Ablation Invariance Root Cause

mechanism: 1. In EXP-033 run_ablations.py, EvidenceResolver was instantiated with enable_candidate_recovery=True across all ablation configurations including A0_baseline.

2. For 28 of the 34 upgraded fields (and all 12 in Cohort B), the preexisting baseline recovery engine (EXP-013/EXP-028F) already resolved the fields under A0_baseline without needing any of the 4 new flags.
3. In Held-Out Cohort B, the ground-truth schema contained zero boolean checkbox fields with non-standard names, zero depth-unit tokens (e.g. 5482'), and zero newline-split strings.

4. Consequently, the 4 new feature flags (ENABLE_BOOLEAN_EXPANSION, ENABLE_TOKEN_STRIP_RECOVERY, ENABLE_GLOBAL_SEARCH_RELAXATION, ENABLE_MULTI_LINE_RECOVERY) had exactly zero activation events on ungrounded scalar fields across the 32 documents of Cohort B.
5. Because the generated candidates were identical across A0, A1, A2, and A3 on Cohort B, the official evaluator produced identical Word Grounding F1 (59.3824%) for all 7 ablation runs.

flag_execution_verification.interpretation: The ablation invariance was NOT due to a caching bug or code error, but because the 4 candidate expansion fixes targeted edge cases (checkboxes, apostrophes, newline breaks) that do not exist in Cohort B's ungrounded scalar fields, while baseline recovery was already solving the clean scalar fields.
